gen-mystery-quest-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Alumni Sans SC has oversized lowercase squeezed tightly together, with stems just a shade heavier than its hairlines, so it reads dense and upright. Mystery Quest adds open-jawed, bookish curves above it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-anaheim: Anaheim packs its rounded glyphs into a dense huddle, and the lowercase fills the line almost like capitals. Anaheim would carry a long passage smoothly, with Mystery Quest's nostalgic, open-jawed curves hovering above it.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-arsenal: Compact ascenders over tall lowercase give Mystery Quest a bookish, nostalgic look, with every curve left open at the jaw. Arsenal follows in plain sans, its x-height near the capitals and its gaps barely registering, so a long stretch runs close-knit and smooth.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-arsenal-sc: Nostalgic through and through, Mystery Quest curves open-jawed over compact ascenders. Arsenal SC sits beneath in plain sans, tightly fitted with a faint thick-thin shift, and it keeps the page contemporary and clean.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-asimovian: Asimovian reads approachable, its lowercase tall and every stroke built from a single width. Mystery Quest is best at bookish, nostalgic display work with open-jawed curves, while Asimovian does its best at steady, uniform text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-basic: Mystery Quest brings nostalgia and open-jawed curves, with compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Basic follows in clean sans, only a gentle bump from small letters to capitals, so a long passage would read professional and smooth.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-cal-sans: Approachable and modern, Cal Sans runs one stroke width throughout, with short ascenders and a tall x-height. Mystery Quest sits above it, bookish and nostalgic with open jaws, and its low modulation makes a pleasing foil.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-changa: Changa reads modern and clean, its lowercase standing as tall as cast iron capitals would. And Mystery Quest lifts the heading with open-jawed curves, giving the page a bookish, nostalgic opening.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-cossette-titre: Open jaws on every curved stroke set Mystery Quest apart, bookish and nostalgic above its compact ascenders. And Cossette Titre follows in sans-serif with welcoming bowls and letters nestled close, capitals barely taller than lowercase.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-epunda-sans: Mystery Quest is bookish and nostalgic, its curves open-jawed beneath compact ascenders over tall lowercase. Epunda Sans brings oversized e and a counters with plenty of daylight inside, and that generous openness is the pair's strongest quality.
